section.book: Bittinger, Beecher, Ellenbogen & Penna, College Algebra: Graphs and Models, 7e
section.title: Analyzing Graphs of Quadratic Functions

title: Axis of symmetry of f(x) = ax^2 + bx + c

problem.prompt: Find the axis of symmetry of f(x) = {tex:f}.

steps.name: find the x-coordinate of the vertex
write the vertical line through it

answer.say: The axis of symmetry is x = {h}.

mistakes.name: used the y-coordinate
mistakes.message: The axis is a vertical line x = h through the vertex: use the x-coordinate.

hints.step: find the x-coordinate of the vertex
hints.why: The axis passes through the vertex.

hints.step: write the vertical line through it
hints.why: A vertical line is x = a constant.
